tsa-a06-v01.quick_english: It itself is called by the word seat-fixing. There the seat is threefold — breath-wind, body, and outer. There first the method in breath: all that course to be stated is reckoned as resting in breath; of it, counting in sequence and non-sequence alone is time. And it shines within the Supreme Lord alone; its shining is the God's power named Kālī; but with division, its appearing in sequence and non-sequence is breath-movement.

tsa-a06-v02.quick_english: For consciousness itself takes a form apart from objects; hence indeed, through being bounded, going to knowability, the void. Then through freedom, falling on the object with eagerness to seize, action-power-led, breathing-formed, living-natured — since with five forms it fills the body, then it shines as it were conscious.

tsa-a06-v03.quick_english: There in power, action is the time-course; in the eastern part, but in the northern, of varied-form nature is the place-course; there of letter-mantra-word courses in time-course is the standing, through beyond-subtle-gross-formedness.

tsa-a06-v04.quick_english: But place-course standing as tattva-person-ray-natured — thus will be in its own place.

tsa-a06-v05.quick_english: There though even in the body, with outer and inner, warp-and-woof-formed is breath — yet of distinctly sensible effort, that from the heart beginning — thus from that alone this is to be described.

tsa-a06-v06.quick_english: There lord-power, self-power, effort — thus a triad is the cause in breath-driving, through secondary-primary states.

tsa-a06-v07.quick_english: There from the heart to the twelve-end's end, by own fingers, of all thirty-six-fingered is the breath-course, in going out and in coming in, since each has fitted strength, effort, and body — of each.

tsa-a06-v08.quick_english: There water-clock, lunar day, month, and year, and as year-group-natured — thus the entire time is completed. There in finger-and-a-fifth, the finger, caṣaka — thus by the rule, ghaṭikā-rise; for a ghaṭikā is sixty caṣakas; hence seventy-two-fingered it is.

tsa-a06-v10.quick_english: Two fingers and a quarter is called tuṭi; in four of them a watch; half tuṭi, half tuṭi — there twilight. Thus in going out day, in coming in night — thus lunar-day rise.

tsa-a06-v12.quick_english: There day is the dark fortnight, night the bright. There first half tuṭi and last half tuṭi is untimed rest; but the middle fifteen alone are tuṭis, lunar days. There light is rest and — thus these alone are day-night.

tsa-a06-v13.quick_english: There the light of knowable-ness is day; of the knowable in the dissolver, dissolution is night. And they — light and rest, through quick-slow variety in endless difference; in sameness with that, equinox.

tsa-a06-v14.quick_english: There in dark fortnight, in breath-sun, the in-breath-moon offers each single fattening digit, until on the fifteenth, in the tuṭi near the twelve-end, the moon whose digit-spread thinned and separated dissolves into breath-sun alone.

tsa-a06-v15.quick_english: Right after that, which half tuṭi — that is the fortnight-joint.

tsa-a06-v16.quick_english: And of it, of the half tuṭi, the eastern half is new-moon, the second first-day.

tsa-a06-v17.quick_english: There on the first-day, in that part, when that new-moon part, from cough-effort-attention-made tithi-cutting, enters — then there is seizure. And there, the Māyā-knower-Rāhu, co-born with the object-moon, by nature unable to dissolve, merely covering-capable, drinks the lunar nectar gone to the sun — thus.

tsa-a06-v18.quick_english: Since making the knower-measure-known triad non-divided, that time is holy, other-world-fruit-giving.

tsa-a06-v19.quick_english: Then entering breath, the awareness-sun with each single digit fills the in-breath-moon, until the fifteenth tuṭi is full moon; right after, fortnight-joint and seizure — thus as before. But this is this-world-fruit-giving — thus month rise.

tsa-a06-v21.quick_english: There the dark fortnight alone is the northern course; in six and six fingers is the passage, from Capricorn up to Gemini's end.

tsa-a06-v22.quick_english: There per finger five lunar days; even there day-night division. Thus in coming in the southern course — womb-ness, birth-wish, about-to-be-born-ness, will-be-born-ness, birth-beginning, being-born-ness, birth-and-six-changes — thus in order among Capricorn and the rest — thus.

tsa-a06-v23.quick_english: Just so worship here does fitting fruit.

tsa-a06-v24.quick_english: And here Dakṣa and the rest up to Grandfather, Rudras and powers — twelve lords — thus year rise.

tsa-a06-v25.quick_english: Per finger sixty lunar days, thus in order at passage a year — thus by this order, in coming and going, twelve-year rise. Per finger of lunar days three hundred in finger-and-a-fifth — a year where before caṣaka was said — thus by counting, at passage five years — thus by this series, in one breath-out-in time sixty-year rise. Here twenty-one thousand six hundred — thus of lunar days the number.

tsa-a06-v26.quick_english: That many alone in day-night is the breath-count — thus not beyond sixty-year rise is examined, from endlessness.

tsa-a06-v27.quick_english: There the human year is the gods' lunar day; by this order twelve thousand divine years are four ages.

tsa-a06-v28.quick_english: Four, three, two, one — thus from kṛta beginning, by so many hundreds, eight twilights.

tsa-a06-v29.quick_english: By seventy-one four-ages a manu-period; by fourteen manu-periods Brahmā's day. At Brahmā-day's end, in the triple world burnt by time-fire, and elsewhere in the triple world smoke-lulled, all people swiftly, fire-driven, in people-world having become pralaya-kevalas, stand.

tsa-a06-v30.quick_english: But awakened Kūṣmāṇḍa, Hāṭakeśa and the rest play in the great world.

tsa-a06-v31.quick_english: Then at night's end Brahmā's emission.

tsa-a06-v32.quick_english: By this measure a hundred years is Brahmā-lifespan.

tsa-a06-v33.quick_english: That is Viṣṇu's day, and that much the night; of him too a hundred is the lifespan.

tsa-a06-v34.quick_english: That day above that is Rudra-world-lord's, Rudra's; that much night; as before a year. That hundred too — and the limit.

tsa-a06-v35.quick_english: There at Rudra's end, going to Śiva-ness; Rudra's stated office-limit. Of world-egg bearers that day; of a hundred Rudras night that much; of them too a hundred is the lifespan.

tsa-a06-v36.quick_english: When a hundred Rudras end — world-egg destruction.

tsa-a06-v37.quick_english: Thus from water-principle up to the unmanifest, this alone in order is the Rudras' lifespan.

tsa-a06-v38.quick_english: The earlier's lifespan is the later's day — thus.

tsa-a06-v39.quick_english: And then Brahmā and Rudras are unobstructed officers standing in the unmanifest — thus.

tsa-a06-v40.quick_english: And then Śrīkaṇṭha-lord is the withdrawer.

tsa-a06-v41.quick_english: This is intermediate dissolution; on its ending, emission.

tsa-a06-v42.quick_english: There other scriptures stated too are emitted.

tsa-a06-v43.quick_english: But Śrīkaṇṭha-lord's own lifespan — that is the sheath-dwellers' Rudras' day, that much the night; their lifespan — that is Gahaneśa-day, that much alone the night; and in her the entire alone dissolves in Māyā.

tsa-a06-v45.quick_english: Thus which unmanifest-time — having multiplied it by ten half-highests one should tell Māyā-day, that much the night.

tsa-a06-v47.quick_english: Māyā-time multiplied by a hundred half-highests is a day in Īśvara-principle.

tsa-a06-v48.quick_english: Here breath emits the world, that much the night. Where breath-quiet — even in breath and in Brahman-cave-abode, in the quiet, which consciousness — even there is sequence.

tsa-a06-v49.quick_english: In Īśvara time multiplied by a hundred half-highests, whatever the number — that is Sadāśiva day, that much the night; that alone is the great dissolution.

tsa-a06-v50.quick_english: Sadāśiva, when own time ends, having ascended drop-half-moon-blocker, dissolves in resonance; resonance in power-principle; that in the pervader; and she in the Unsupported.

tsa-a06-v51.quick_english: By power-time multiplied by ten-million half-highests — Unsupported-day.

tsa-a06-v52.quick_english: The Unsupported in the like-minded station — which, that likeness, sameness; that is Brahman.

tsa-a06-v53.quick_english: From this likeness, from the partless, from time, by mere winking measure — the stated wheel-whirl rise of all time's spread and re-dissolution.

tsa-a06-v54.quick_english: One, ten, hundred, thousand, ten thousand, hundred thousand, million, ten million, hundred million, billion, ten billion, hundred billion, thousand billion, ten thousand billion, ocean, end, middle, half-highest — thus in order ten-multiplied — eighteen — thus the counting-rule.

tsa-a06-v55.quick_english: Thus countless emissions-dissolutions in one great-emission-formed breath — it too in consciousness, she in the adjunct, it in bare awareness, of bare awareness alone — this pulse which is called this time-rise.

tsa-a06-v56.quick_english: From that alone, in dream-fancy and the rest, variety of this brings no contradiction.

tsa-a06-v57.quick_english: Thus as in out-breath is time-rise, so too in in-breath, from the heart to the root-seat's end.

tsa-a06-v58.quick_english: And as in heart-throat-palate-brow-cleft-twelve-ends the six causes called Brahmā-Viṣṇu-Rudra-Īśa-Sadāśiva-Unsupported, just so too in in-breath, in heart-bulb-bliss-contraction-expansion-twelve-ends — these childhood-youth-age-rebirth-release lords.

tsa-a06-v60.quick_english: The equal-breath, moving in the ten heart-channels, conveys juices and the rest evenly through the whole body. There moving in the eight directions, it imitates as it were the regents' doings of the knower.

tsa-a06-v61.quick_english: But moving up and down, in three channels it does going-coming.

tsa-a06-v62.quick_english: There on equinox-day, outside, at dawn-time, a ghaṭikā and a quarter it carries in the middle path.

tsa-a06-v63.quick_english: Then nine hundred breath-castings — thus by counting outside two and a half ghaṭikās — left, right, left, right, left — thus five passages.

tsa-a06-v64.quick_english: Then when the five-passage has elapsed, in fourteen less-a-quarter passed ghaṭikās, at southern autumnal equinox-midday, nine breath-hundreds.

tsa-a06-v65.quick_english: Then too right, left, right, left, right — thus a five-passage, nine hundred each — thus even at night — thus.

tsa-a06-v66.quick_english: Thus on equinox-day and its night, twelve and twelve passages.

tsa-a06-v67.quick_english: Then in day wax-wane, passage wax-wane.

tsa-a06-v68.quick_english: Thus in one equal-breath-wind two years, from absence of in-out-breath union.

tsa-a06-v69.quick_english: Even here twelve-year-rise and the rest as before.

tsa-a06-v70.quick_english: But in up-breath the course is twelve-end-limited, of time mere-pulse-natured.

tsa-a06-v71.quick_english: Even here as before the rule.

tsa-a06-v72.quick_english: But in pervading-breath, from pervasiveness, even in non-sequence, by subtle-surging-ness is time-rise.

tsa-a06-v74.quick_english: There in half-watch, in half-watch, class-rise is even at equinox; of the letter, of the letter, two hundred sixteen breaths; outside thirty-six caṣakas — thus this rise, effortless-born letter-rise.

tsa-a06-v75.quick_english: But effort-born is mantra-rise: like a water-wheel-device drawing, by single-attention force — wondrous mantra-rise day-night keeping joined — with the mantra-deity gains identity.

tsa-a06-v76.quick_english: There in the ever-arisen, by breath-course count alone is rise-count explained; when that doubled, its half, and the rest in order; in the hundred-and-eight wheel, two hundred the rise — thus in order. In gross-subtle course-nature of the rested one, when breath-course thins, when time is devoured come about, complete, one, just this awareness, wonder-power-filled, shines.

tsa-a06-v77.quick_english: Time-difference alone divides awareness, not object-difference — like peak-abiding knowledge. Of knowing, as much as the abiding-time, that alone is the moment. And in one breath-rise, one knowing alone necessarily — and this: otherwise there would be no single thought-knowing at all, since word-sequenced-stained, since even the measure is sequential.

tsa-a06-v78.quick_english: Which has said: his beginning, raised, half-short — thus.

tsa-a06-v79.quick_english: Therefore until between pulses has not arisen, so long one knowing alone.

tsa-a06-v80.quick_english: Hence very eighty-one, when remembering the word, through entering various natures — that one alone, having the Lord as object, thought, when time is devoured, results as thought-free-natured alone — thus.

tsa-a06-v81.quick_english: Thus seeing the entire time-course in breath-rise alone, and the various countless emissions-dissolutions, noting right there, by self alone recognizing lordship — one is freed alone — thus.

tsa-a06-v82.quick_english: Seeing the awareness-formed self's breath-power, the form going there and beyond time together, with emission-stay-dissolution wheels, ever-ready attains Bhairavī-being.

tsa-a06-v01.speaker: Teacher (seat-fixing charter)
tsa-a06-v01.question: What is the seat, and what is time?
premises: sa eva sthānaprakalpanaśabdena uktaḥ — called by the seat-fixing word.
tatra tridhā sthānaṃ prāṇavāyuḥ śarīraṃ bāhyaṃ ca — three seats: breath, body, outer.
tatra prāṇe tāvat vidhiḥ — first the breath-method.
sarvaḥ asau vakṣyamāṇaḥ adhvā prāṇasthaḥ kalyate — the whole course to be stated is reckoned breath-resting.
tasya kramākramakalanaiva kālaḥ — its sequence/non-sequence counting alone is time.
sa ca parameśvara eva antarbhāti — it shines within the Lord alone.
tadbhāsanaṃ ca devasya kālī nāma śaktiḥ — its shining is the God's power Kālī.
bhedena tu tadābhāsanaṃ kramākramayoḥ prāṇavṛttiḥ — with division, its appearing is breath-movement.
tsa-a06-v01.inference: Charter: three seats; breath first; course reckoned in breath; time = counting; Kālī within, breath-movement without.

tsa-a06-v02.speaker: Teacher (consciousness to breath)
tsa-a06-v02.question: How does consciousness become breath?
premises: saṃvid eva hi prameyebhyo vibhaktaṃ rūpaṃ gṛhṇāti — consciousness takes an apart-form from objects.
ata eva ca avacchedayogāt vedyatāṃ yāntī nabhaḥ — bounded, going to knowability: the void.
tataḥ svātantryāt meye svīkārautsukyena nipatantī — by freedom falling on the object, eager to seize.
kriyāśaktipradhānā prāṇanārūpā jīvasvabhāvā — action-led, breathing-formed, living-natured.
pañcabhī rūpaiḥ dehaṃ yataḥ pūrayati tato 'sau cetana iva bhāti — filling the body with five forms, it shines as if conscious.
tsa-a06-v02.inference: Descent: consciousness → apart-form → void → seizing-fall → breathing → seeming-conscious body.

tsa-a06-v03.speaker: Teacher (course map)
tsa-a06-v03.question: How are the courses placed?
premises: tatra kriyā śaktau kālādhvā — in power, action is time-course.
prācyabhāge uttare tu mūrtivaicitryarūpo deśādhvā — east and north: varied-form place-course.
tatra varṇamantrapadādhvanaḥ kālādhvani sthitiḥ parasūkṣmasthūlarūpatvāt — letter-mantra-word courses stand in time-course, beyond-subtle-gross.
tsa-a06-v03.inference: Placement: action=time-course in power; varied place-course east/north; letter-courses stand in time.

tsa-a06-v04.speaker: Teacher (deferral)
tsa-a06-v04.question: Where is place-course detail?
premises: deśādhvasthitis tu tattvapurakalātmanā — place-standing as tattva-person-ray-natured.
iti bhaviṣyati svāvasare — will be in its own place.
tsa-a06-v04.inference: Place-course deferred to its own place.

tsa-a06-v05.speaker: Teacher (why breath first)
tsa-a06-v05.question: Why describe from the heart?
premises: tatra yady api dehe sabāhyābhyantaram otaprotarūpaḥ prāṇaḥ — though in the body, warp-and-woof, is breath.
tathāpi prasphuṭasaṃvedyaprayatnaḥ asau hṛdayāt prabhṛti — yet distinctly felt effort starts from the heart.
iti tata eva ayaṃ nirūpaṇīyaḥ — hence described from there alone.
tsa-a06-v05.inference: Felt effort starts at the heart; description starts there.

tsa-a06-v06.speaker: Teacher (breath drivers)
tsa-a06-v06.question: What moves breath?
premises: tatra prabhuśaktiḥ ātmaśaktiḥ yatna iti tritayaṃ prāṇeraṇe hetuḥ — lord-power, self-power, effort: triad cause of breath-driving.
guṇamukhyabhāvāt — through secondary-primary states.
tsa-a06-v06.inference: Triad of drivers in ranked states.

tsa-a06-v07.speaker: Teacher (breath measure)
tsa-a06-v07.question: How long is the breath-course?
premises: tatra hṛdayāt dvādaśāntāntaṃ svāṅgulaiḥ sarvasya ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaḥ prāṇacāraḥ — heart to twelve-end's end: 36 fingers by own fingers.
nirgame praveśe ca svocitabalayatnadehatvāt sarvasya — out and in, each fitted.

tsa-a06-v08.speaker: Teacher (time completed)
tsa-a06-v08.question: How is all time in breath?
premises: tatra ghaṭikā tithiḥ māso varṣaṃ ca varṣasamūhātmā iti samastaḥ kālaḥ parisamāpyate — clock, lunar day, month, year, year-groups: all time completed.
tatra sapañcāṃśe aṅgule caṣaka iti sthityā ghaṭikodayaḥ — finger-and-a-fifth = caṣaka: ghaṭikā-rise.
ghaṭikā hi ṣaṣṭyā caṣakaiḥ tasmāt dvāsaptatyaṅgulā bhavati — 60 caṣakas = 72 fingers.
tsa-a06-v08.inference: Whole time completed in breath; caṣaka rule; 72-finger ghaṭikā.

tsa-a06-v09.speaker: Teacher (next topic)
tsa-a06-v09.question: What next?
premises: atha tithyudayaḥ — now lunar-day rise.

tsa-a06-v10.speaker: Teacher (tuṭi)
tsa-a06-v10.question: What is a tuṭi?
premises: sapādam aṅguladvayaṃ tuṭiḥ ucyate — 2¼ fingers called tuṭi.
tāsu catasṛṣu praharaḥ — four make a watch.
tuṭyardhaṃ tuṭyardhaṃ tatra saṃdhyā — half each end: twilight.
evaṃ nirgame dinaṃ praveśe rātriḥ iti tithyudayaḥ — out-breath day, in-breath night.
tsa-a06-v10.inference: Tuṭi measure; watch; twilight; day-night breathing.

tsa-a06-v11.speaker: Teacher (next topic)
tsa-a06-v11.question: What next?
premises: atha māsodayaḥ — now month rise.

tsa-a06-v12.speaker: Teacher (fortnight)
tsa-a06-v12.question: How is the fortnight built?
premises: tatra dinaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣaḥ rātriḥ śuklaḥ — day dark fortnight, night bright.
tatra pūrvaṃ tuṭyardham antyaṃ ca tuṭyardhaṃ viśrāntiḥ akālakalitāḥ — first and last half-tuṭi: untimed rest.
madhyās tu pañcadaśa tuṭaya eva tithayaḥ — middle fifteen alone: lunar days.
tatra prakāśo viśrāntiś ca iti ete eva dinaniśe — light and rest: just these are day-night.
tsa-a06-v12.inference: Untimed rests at ends; fifteen middle tuṭis are the days.

tsa-a06-v13.speaker: Teacher (day-night doctrine)
tsa-a06-v13.question: What are day and night?
premises: tatra vedyamayatāprakāśo dinaṃ — knowable-light is day.
vedyasya vicārayitari layo rātriḥ — knowable dissolved in the dissolver: night.
te ca prakāśaviśrāntī cirāciravaicitryāt anantabhede — light-rest through quick-slow variety in endless difference.
tatsāmye tu viṣuvat — in sameness: equinox.
tsa-a06-v13.inference: Day = knowable-light; night = dissolution; variety endless; sameness = equinox.

tsa-a06-v14.speaker: Teacher (waxing)
tsa-a06-v14.question: How does the moon fill?
premises: tatra kṛṣṇapakṣe prāṇārke apānacandra āpyāyikām ekām ekāṃ kalām arpayati — in dark fortnight, in breath-sun, in-breath-moon offers each fattening digit.
yāvat pañcadaśyāṃ tuṭau dvādaśāntasamīpe kṣīṇapṛthagbhūtakalāprasaraḥ candramāḥ prāṇārka eva līyate — by the fifteenth, near the twelve-end, the thinned moon dissolves into breath-sun.
tsa-a06-v14.inference: Fifteen digit-offerings; thinned moon dissolves at the end.

tsa-a06-v15.speaker: Teacher (joint)
tsa-a06-v15.question: What is pakṣasaṃdhi?
premises: tadanantaraṃ yat tuṭyardhaṃ sa pakṣasaṃdhiḥ — right after, the half-tuṭi: fortnight-joint.

tsa-a06-v16.speaker: Teacher (joint halves)
tsa-a06-v16.question: How is the joint divided?
premises: tasya ca tuṭyardhasya prācyam ardham āmāvasyam dvitīyaṃ prātipadam — eastern half new-moon, second first-day.

tsa-a06-v17.speaker: Teacher (eclipse)
tsa-a06-v17.question: What is the seizure?
premises: tatra prātipade tasmin bhāge yadā ... tithicchedāt viśati — on that first-day part, when from tithi-cutting it enters.
tadā tatra grahaṇam — then seizure.
tatra ca vedyarūpasomasahabhūto māyāpramātṛrāhuḥ — the Māyā-knower-Rāhu, co-born with the object-moon.
svabhāvatayā vilāpanāśaktaḥ kevalam ācchādanamātrasamarthaḥ — by nature unable to dissolve, merely covering-capable.
sūryagataṃ cāndram amṛtaṃ pibati — drinks the lunar nectar gone to the sun.
kāsaprayatnāvadhānādikṛtāt — from observance-effort.
tsa-a06-v17.inference: Eclipse doctrine: Rāhu covers but cannot dissolve; drinks the nectar.

tsa-a06-v18.speaker: Teacher (holy time)
tsa-a06-v18.question: Why is it holy?
premises: pramātṛpramāṇaprameyatritayāvibhāgakāritvāt sa puṇyaḥ kālaḥ pāralaukikaphalapradaḥ — making the triad non-divided: holy time, other-world-fruiting.

tsa-a06-v19.speaker: Teacher (waning)
tsa-a06-v19.question: How does waning work?
premises: tataḥ praviśati prāṇe cidarka ekaikayā kalayā apānacandram āpūrayati — then in breath the awareness-sun fills the in-breath-moon digit by digit.
yāvat pañcadaśī tuṭiḥ pūrṇimā — until the fifteenth tuṭi: full moon.
tadanantaraṃ pakṣasaṃdhiḥ grahaṇaṃ ca iti prāgvat — then joint and seizure as before.
etat tu aihikaphalapradam iti māsodayaḥ — but this-world-fruiting: month rise.
tsa-a06-v19.inference: Waning as filling; same joint/seizure; this-world fruit.

tsa-a06-v20.speaker: Teacher (next topic)
tsa-a06-v20.question: What next?
premises: atha varṣodayaḥ — now year rise.

tsa-a06-v21.speaker: Teacher (northern course)
tsa-a06-v21.question: How is the northern course measured?
premises: tatra kṛṣṇapakṣa eva uttarāyaṇam — dark fortnight alone: northern course.
ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu aṅguleṣu saṃkrāntiḥ makarāt mithunāntām — every six fingers a passage, Capricorn to Gemini's end.

tsa-a06-v22.speaker: Teacher (southern course)
tsa-a06-v22.question: What happens coming in?
premises: tatra pratyaṅgulaṃ pañca tithayaḥ tatrāpi dinarātrivibhāgaḥ — per finger five days, with day-night division.

evaṃ praveśe dakṣiṇāyanaṃ garbhatvam udbhavecchā ... janmādivikāraṣaṭkaṃ ca iti kramāt makarādiṣu — coming in: southern course — womb-ness through birth-and-six-changes, in order among Capricorn and the rest.
tsa-a06-v22.inference: In-breath southern course with gestation-to-change series.

tsa-a06-v23.speaker: Teacher (worship fruit)
tsa-a06-v23.question: Does worship matter?
premises: tathaiva upāsā atra phalaṃ samucitaṃ karoti — just so worship here does fitting fruit.

tsa-a06-v24.speaker: Teacher (year lords)
tsa-a06-v24.question: Who rules the year?
premises: atra ca dakṣādyāḥ pitāmahāntā rudrāḥ śaktayaś ca dvādaśādhipataya iti varṣodayaḥ — Dakṣa to Grandfather, Rudras and powers: twelve lords.

tsa-a06-v25.speaker: Teacher (great counts)
tsa-a06-v25.question: How do the counts scale?
premises: pratyaṅgulaṃ ṣaṣṭiḥ tithaya iti krameṇa saṃkrāntau varṣam — per finger sixty days: at passage a year.
anena krameṇa praveśanirgamayoḥ dvādaśābdodayaḥ — thus coming-going: twelve-year rise.
pratyaṅgulaṃ tithīnāṃ śatatrayaṃ sapañcāṃśe 'ṅgule varṣaṃ — per finger 300 days in finger-and-a-fifth: a year.
yatra prāk caṣakam uktam iti gaṇanayā saṃkrāntau pañca varṣāṇi — where caṣaka was said: by counting five years at passage.
anayā paripāṭyā ekasmin prāṇanirgamapraveśakāle ṣaṣṭyabdodayaḥ — in one out-in time: sixty-year rise.
atra ekaviṃśatisahasrāṇi ṣaṭ śatāni iti tithīnāṃ saṃkhyā — 21,600 the day-count.

tsa-a06-v26.speaker: Teacher (limit of inquiry)
tsa-a06-v26.question: How far examine?
premises: tāvatī eva ahorātre prāṇasaṃkhyā — that many alone the day-night breath-count.
iti na ṣaṣṭyabdodayāt adhikaṃ parīkṣyate ānantyāt — not beyond sixty-year rise examined, from endlessness.
tsa-a06-v26.inference: Inquiry stops at sixty-year rise; rest endless.

tsa-a06-v27.speaker: Teacher (cosmic scale)
tsa-a06-v27.question: How do divine years work?
premises: tatra mānuṣaṃ varṣaṃ devānāṃ tithiḥ — human year = gods' lunar day.
anena krameṇa divyāni dvādaśavarṣasahasrāṇi caturyugam — thus 12,000 divine years = four ages.
tsa-a06-v27.inference: Human year = divine day; 12,000 divine years = four ages.

tsa-a06-v28.speaker: Teacher (twilights)
tsa-a06-v28.question: What are the twilights?
premises: catvāri trīṇi dve ekam iti kṛtāt prabhṛti tāvadbhiḥ śataiḥ aṣṭau saṃdhyāḥ — 4,3,2,1 from kṛta on: by so many hundreds, eight twilights.

tsa-a06-v29.speaker: Teacher (Brahmā-day)
tsa-a06-v29.question: What happens on Brahmā's day?
premises: caturyugānām ekasaptatyā manvantaram — 71 four-ages = manu-period.
manvantaraiḥ caturdaśabhiḥ brāhmaṃ dinam — 14 = Brahmā's day.
brahmadinānte kālāgnidagdhe lokatraye ... sarve janā vegavad agnipreritā janaloke pralayākalībhūya tiṣṭhanti — at its end, worlds burnt/lulled, all stand as pralayākalas in people-world.

tsa-a06-v30.speaker: Teacher (the awake)
tsa-a06-v30.question: Who plays on?
premises: prabuddhās tu kūṣmāṇḍahāṭakeśādyāḥ maholoke krīḍanti — awakened Kūṣmāṇḍa and the rest play in the great world.

tsa-a06-v31.speaker: Teacher (dawn)
tsa-a06-v31.question: What after night?
premises: tato niśāsamāptau brāhmī sṛṣṭiḥ — then at night's end, Brahmā's emission.

tsa-a06-v32.speaker: Teacher (Brahmā-span)
tsa-a06-v32.question: How long is Brahmā?
premises: anena mānena varṣaśataṃ brahmāyuḥ — by this measure 100 years = Brahmā-lifespan.

tsa-a06-v33.speaker: Teacher (Viṣṇu-span)
tsa-a06-v33.question: How long is Viṣṇu?
premises: tat viṣṇoḥ dinaṃ tāvatī ca rātriḥ — that Viṣṇu's day, that much night.
tasyāpi śatam āyuḥ — his too a hundred lifespan.

tsa-a06-v34.speaker: Teacher (Rudra-span)
tsa-a06-v34.question: What of Rudra?
premises: tat dinaṃ tadūrdhve rudralokaprabho rudrasya — that day; above that — Rudra-world-lord — Rudra's.
tāvatī rātriḥ prāgvat varṣaṃ tacchatam api ca avadhiḥ — that much night; year as before; that hundred too: the limit.
tsa-a06-v34.inference: Day above; night alike; hundred-year limit.
uncertainties: rudralokaprabho fork: vocative address vs nominative descriptor.

option_choices.reason: mid-exposition hail fits teacher voice; bare nominative leaves verb wanting

tsa-a06-v35.speaker: Teacher (Rudra's end)
tsa-a06-v35.question: What ends Rudra?
premises: tatra rudrasya tadavasitau śivatvagatiḥ — at Rudra's end, going to Śiva-ness.
rudrasya uktādhikāravadhiḥ — Rudra's stated office-limit.
brahmāṇḍadhārakāṇāṃ tat dinaṃ śatarudrāṇāṃ niśā — world-bearers' day; hundred Rudras' night.
tāvatī teṣām api ca śatam āyuḥ — that much; their too a hundred lifespan.
tsa-a06-v35.inference: Office-limit ends in Śiva-ness; hundred-Rudra scale.

tsa-a06-v36.speaker: Teacher (world-egg end)
tsa-a06-v36.question: What ends the world-egg?
premises: śatarudrakṣaye brahmāṇḍavināśaḥ — when a hundred Rudras end: world-egg destruction.

tsa-a06-v37.speaker: Teacher (Rudra scale)
tsa-a06-v37.question: How far does the Rudra scale run?
premises: evaṃ jalatattvāt avyaktāntam etad eva krameṇa rudrāṇām āyuḥ — from water-principle to unmanifest: this in order the Rudras' lifespan.

tsa-a06-v38.speaker: Teacher (ladder rule)
tsa-a06-v38.question: What is the ladder rule?
premises: pūrvasya āyur uttarasya dinam iti — the earlier's lifespan is the later's day.
tsa-a06-v38.inference: Fused-span rule: each lifespan = next one's day.

tsa-a06-v39.speaker: Teacher (officers)
tsa-a06-v39.question: Who stands in the unmanifest?
premises: tataś ca brahmā rudrāś ca abādyadhikāriṇaḥ avyakte tiṣṭhanti — Brahmā and Rudras, unobstructed officers, stand in the unmanifest.

tsa-a06-v40.speaker: Teacher (withdrawer)
tsa-a06-v40.question: Who withdraws?
premises: śrīkaṇṭhanāthaś ca tadā saṃhartā — Śrīkaṇṭha-lord then the withdrawer.

tsa-a06-v41.speaker: Teacher (interval)
tsa-a06-v41.question: What between dissolutions?
premises: eṣo 'vāntarapralayaḥ — this intermediate dissolution.
tatkṣaye sṛṣṭiḥ — on its ending, emission.

tsa-a06-v42.speaker: Teacher (other texts)
tsa-a06-v42.question: What of other scriptures?
premises: tatra śāstrāntaram uktā api sṛjyante — other scriptures, stated, too are emitted.
uncertainties: uktā fork: f.pl with implied emissions (verb decisive) vs scribal neuter.

option_choices.reason: plural verb sṛjyante decisive; neuter leaves verb unexplained

tsa-a06-v43.speaker: Teacher (higher days)
tsa-a06-v43.question: How do higher days scale?
premises: yat tu śrīkaṇṭhanāthasya svam āyuḥ tat kañcukavāsināṃ rudrāṇāṃ dinaṃ — Śrīkaṇṭha's lifespan = sheath-dwellers' day.
tāvatī rajanī — that much night.
teṣāṃ yad āyuḥ tat gahaneśadinaṃ — their lifespan = Gahaneśa-day.
tāvatī eva kṣapā tasyāṃ ca samastam eva māyāyāṃ vilīyate — that much night; in her all dissolves in Māyā.

tsa-a06-v44.speaker: Teacher (re-emission)
tsa-a06-v44.question: What after Māyā?
premises: punaḥ gahaneśaḥ sṛjati — again Gahaneśa emits.

tsa-a06-v45.speaker: Teacher (Māyā-day)
tsa-a06-v45.question: How is Māyā-day told?
premises: evaṃ yaḥ avyaktakālaḥ taṃ daśabhiḥ parārdhaiḥ guṇayitvā māyādinaṃ kathayet — unmanifest-time times ten half-highests: tell Māyā-day.
tāvatī rātriḥ — that much night.

tsa-a06-v46.speaker: Teacher (seal)
tsa-a06-v46.question: What is that?
premises: sa eva pralayaḥ — that alone is dissolution.

tsa-a06-v47.speaker: Teacher (Īśvara-day)
tsa-a06-v47.question: How is Īśvara-day?
premises: māyākālaḥ parārdhaśataguṇita aiśvaratattve dinam — Māyā-time times a hundred half-highests: a day in Īśvara-principle.

tsa-a06-v48.speaker: Teacher (breath-quiet)
tsa-a06-v48.question: What where breath quiets?
premises: atra prāṇo jagat sṛjati tāvatī rātriḥ — here breath emits the world, that much night.
yatra prāṇapraśamaḥ prāṇe ca brahmabiladhāmni śānte 'pi yā saṃvit tatrāpy asti kramaḥ — where breath quiets, even in the quiet Brahman-cave, which consciousness: even there is sequence.
tsa-a06-v48.inference: Even in quiet, consciousness keeps sequence.

tsa-a06-v49.speaker: Teacher (great dissolution)
tsa-a06-v49.question: What is the great dissolution?
premises: aiśvare kāle parārdhaśataguṇite yā saṃkhyā tat sādāśivaṃ dinaṃ tāvatī niśā — in hundred-multiplied Īśvara-time, the number: Sadāśiva day, that much night.
sa eva mahāpralayaḥ — that alone great dissolution.

tsa-a06-v50.speaker: Teacher (ascent)
tsa-a06-v50.question: How does Sadāśiva dissolve?
premises: sadāśivaḥ svakālaparikṣaye bindvardhacandranirodhikām ākramya nāde līyate — when his time ends, ascending drop-half-moon-blocker, dissolves in resonance.
nādaḥ śaktitattve tat vyāpinyāṃ sā ca anāśrite — resonance in power-principle, that in the pervader, she in the Unsupported.
tsa-a06-v50.inference: Ascent ladder: drop → resonance → power → pervader → Unsupported.

tsa-a06-v51.speaker: Teacher (Unsupported-day)
tsa-a06-v51.question: How is Unsupported-day?
premises: śaktikālena parārdhakoṭiguṇitena anāśritadinam — by power-time times ten-million half-highests: Unsupported-day.

tsa-a06-v52.speaker: Teacher (Brahman)
tsa-a06-v52.question: What is Brahman?
premises: anāśritaḥ sāmanase pade yat tat sāmanasyaṃ sāmyaṃ tat brahma — the Unsupported in the like-minded station: which, that likeness, sameness; that is Brahman.
uncertainties: sāmanase sense obscure; still-place reading from station frame.

tsa-a06-v53.speaker: Teacher (wheel-whirl)
tsa-a06-v53.question: How does time turn?
premises: asmāt sāmanasyāt akalyāt kālāt nimeṣonmeṣamātratayā proktāśeṣakālaprasarapravilayacakrabhramodayaḥ — from likeness, from partless, from time, by winking measure: the stated wheel-whirl rise of all time's spread and re-dissolution.

tsa-a06-v54.speaker: Teacher (number names)
tsa-a06-v54.question: How are numbers named?
premises: ekaṃ daśa śataṃ sahasram ayutaṃ lakṣaṃ niyutaṃ koṭiḥ arbudaṃ vṛndaṃ kharvaṃ nikharvaṃ padmaṃ śaṅkuḥ samudram antyaṃ madhyam parārdham iti — one to half-highest.
krameṇa daśaguṇitāni aṣṭādaśa iti gaṇitavidhiḥ — ten-multiplied in order, eighteen: counting-rule.

tsa-a06-v55.speaker: Teacher (all in breath)
tsa-a06-v55.question: Where do all creations rest?
premises: evam asaṃkhyāḥ sṛṣṭipralayāḥ ekasmin mahāsṛṣṭirūpe prāṇe — countless emissions-dissolutions in one great-emission-formed breath.

so 'pi saṃvidi sā upādhau sa cinmātre cinmātrasyaiva ayaṃ spando yad ayaṃ kālayodo nāma — it in consciousness, she in adjunct, it in bare awareness: of bare awareness alone this pulse called time-rise.
tsa-a06-v55.inference: All in breath; breath in consciousness; time-rise = bare-awareness pulse.

tsa-a06-v56.speaker: Teacher (no contradiction)
tsa-a06-v56.question: Why no contradiction?
premises: tata eva svapnasaṃkalpādau vaicitryam asya na virodhāvaham — from that alone, in dream-fancy and the rest, its variety brings no contradiction.

tsa-a06-v57.speaker: Teacher (apāna)
tsa-a06-v57.question: What of in-breath?
premises: evaṃ yathā prāṇe kālodayaḥ tathā apāne 'pi hṛdayāt mūlapīṭhaparyantam — as in out-breath time-rise, so in in-breath, heart to root-seat's end.
tsa-a06-v57.inference: Same rise in in-breath, heart to root-seat.

tsa-a06-v58.speaker: Teacher (six causes)
tsa-a06-v58.question: What are the six causes?
premises: yathā ca hṛtkaṇṭhatālulalāṭarandhradvādaśānteṣu brahmaviṣṇurudreśasadāśivānāśritākhyaṃ kāraṇaṣaṭkam tathaiva apāne 'pi — as in heart-to-twelve-ends the six Brahmā-to-Unsupported causes, so in in-breath.
hṛtkandānandasaṃkocavikāsadvādaśānteṣu bālyayauvanavārddhakyapunarbhavamuktyadhipataya ete — in heart-bulb-bliss-contraction-expansion-twelve-ends: childhood-to-release lords.
tsa-a06-v58.inference: Six causes above; six lords below.

tsa-a06-v59.speaker: Teacher (samāna)
tsa-a06-v59.question: What next?
premises: atha samāne kālodayaḥ — now in equal-breath time-rise.

tsa-a06-v60.speaker: Teacher (equal-breath)
tsa-a06-v60.question: How does samāna move?
premises: samāno hārdīṣu daśāsu nāḍīṣu saṃcaran samaste dehe sāmyena rasādīn vāhayati — moving in ten heart-channels, conveys juices evenly through the body.
tatra digaṣṭake saṃcaran taddikpaticeṣṭām iva pramātuḥ anukārayati — in the eight directions, imitates as it were the regents' doings.
tsa-a06-v60.inference: Ten channels, even juices; eight-direction regent-mime.

tsa-a06-v61.speaker: Teacher (vertical)
tsa-a06-v61.question: What of up-down?
premises: ūrdhvādhas tu saṃcaran tisṛṣu nāḍīṣu gatāgataṃ karoti — moving up and down, in three channels does going-coming.

tsa-a06-v62.speaker: Teacher (equinox breath)
tsa-a06-v62.question: What on equinox-day?
premises: tatra viṣuvaddine bāhye prabhātakāle sapādāṃ ghaṭikāṃ madhyamārge vahati — on equinox-day, outside, at dawn, carries 1¼ ghaṭikās in the middle path.

tsa-a06-v63.speaker: Teacher (left-right)
tsa-a06-v63.question: How do passages alternate?
premises: tato navaśatāni prāṇavikṣepāṇām iti gaṇanayā bahiḥ sārdhaghaṭikādvayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe vāme dakṣiṇe vāme iti pañca saṃkrāntayaḥ — 900 breath-castings; outside 2½ ghaṭikās left-right-left-right-left: five passages.

tsa-a06-v64.speaker: Teacher (southern)
tsa-a06-v64.question: What at southern solstice?
premises: tataḥ saṃkrāntipañcake vṛtte pādonāsu caturdaśasu ghaṭikāsu atikrāntāsu — five-passage elapsed, in 13¾ passed ghaṭikās.
dakṣiṇaṃ śāradaṃ viṣuvanmadhyāhne nava prāṇaśatāni — southern autumnal: at equinox-midday nine breath-hundreds.

tsa-a06-v65.speaker: Teacher (night)
tsa-a06-v65.question: And at night?
premises: tato 'pi dakṣiṇe vāme ... pañca saṃkrāntipañcakaṃ pratyekaṃ navaśatāni ity evaṃ rātrāv api — right-left five-passage, 900 each; thus even at night.

tsa-a06-v66.speaker: Teacher (twelve)
tsa-a06-v66.question: How many passages?
premises: evaṃ viṣuvaddivase tadrātrau ca dvādaśa dvādaśa saṃkrāntayaḥ — on equinox-day and its night, twelve and twelve.
tsa-a06-v66.inference: Twelve by day, twelve by night.

tsa-a06-v67.speaker: Teacher (wax-wane)
tsa-a06-v67.question: What varies?
premises: tato dinavṛddhikṣayeṣu saṃkrāntivṛddhikṣayaḥ — in day wax-wane, passage wax-wane.

tsa-a06-v68.speaker: Teacher (two years)
tsa-a06-v68.question: How two years in one?
premises: evam ekasmin samānamaruti varṣadvayaṃ śvāsapraśvāsayogābhāvāt — in one equal-breath-wind two years, from absence of in-out-breath union.

tsa-a06-v69.speaker: Teacher (same rule)
tsa-a06-v69.question: What of the rest?
premises: atrāpi dvādaśābdodayādi pūrvavat — even here twelve-year-rise and the rest as before.

tsa-a06-v70.speaker: Teacher (up-breath)
tsa-a06-v70.question: What of udāna?
premises: udāne tu dvādaśāntāvadhiś cāraḥ spandamātrātmanaḥ kālasya — in up-breath the course is twelve-end-limited, of mere-pulse-natured time.

tsa-a06-v71.speaker: Teacher (same rule)
tsa-a06-v71.question: What rule?
premises: atrāpi pūrvavat vidhiḥ — even here as before the rule.

tsa-a06-v72.speaker: Teacher (vyāna)
tsa-a06-v72.question: What of vyāna?
premises: vyāne tu vyāpakatvāt akrame 'pi sūkṣmocchalattāyogena kālodayaḥ — in pervading-breath, from pervasiveness, even in non-sequence, by subtle-surging-ness: time-rise.

tsa-a06-v73.speaker: Teacher (next topic)
tsa-a06-v73.question: What next?
premises: atha varṇodayaḥ — now letter rise.

tsa-a06-v74.speaker: Teacher (letter rise)
tsa-a06-v74.question: How do letters rise?
premises: tatra ardhaprahare ardhaprahare vargodayo viṣuvati samaḥ — half-watch by half-watch class-rise is even at equinox.
varṇasya varṇasya dve śate ṣoḍaśādhike prāṇānām bahiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśat caṣakāṇi — per letter 216 breaths; outside 36 caṣakas.
iti udayaḥ ayam ayatnajo varṇodayaḥ — thus effortless-born letter-rise.

tsa-a06-v75.speaker: Teacher (mantra rise)
tsa-a06-v75.question: How does mantra rise?
premises: yatnajas tu mantrodayaḥ araghaṭṭaghaṭīyantravāhanavat — effort-born mantra-rise, like a water-wheel drawing.
ekānusaṃdhibalāt citraṃ mantrodayaṃ divāniśam anusaṃdadhat mantradevatayā saha tādātmyam eti — by single-attention force, joining wondrous mantra-rise day-night, gains identity with the mantra-deity.

tsa-a06-v76.speaker: Teacher (grāsa)
tsa-a06-v76.question: What is time-devouring?
premises: tatra sadodite prāṇacārasaṃkhyayaiva udayasaṃkhyā vyākhyātā — in the ever-arisen, rise-count explained by breath-count alone.
taddviguṇite tadardham ityādi krameṇa aṣṭottaraśate cakre dviśata udayaḥ — doubling, halving, in 108-wheel 200 rise.
iti krameṇa sthūlasūkṣme cārasvarūpe viśrāntasya prāṇacāre kṣīṇe kālagrāse vṛtte — in gross-subtle course-nature of the rested, breath thinned, time devoured come about.
sampūrṇām ekam evedaṃ saṃvedanaṃ citraśaktinirbharaṃ bhāsate — complete one just-this awareness, wonder-filled, shines.
tsa-a06-v76.inference: Count by breath alone; thinning; devouring; complete awareness shines.

tsa-a06-v77.speaker: Teacher (moment doctrine)
tsa-a06-v77.question: What is a moment?
premises: kālabheda eva saṃvedanabhedakaḥ na vedyabhedaḥ — time-difference alone divides awareness, not object-difference.
śikharasthajñānavat — like peak-abiding knowledge.
jñānasya yāvān avasthitikālaḥ sa eva kṣaṇaḥ — as much as knowing's abiding-time: that alone the moment.
prāṇodaye ca ekasmin ekam eva jñānam avaśyaṃ — in one breath-rise necessarily one knowing.
caitat anyathā vikalpajñānam ekaṃ na kiṃcit syāt — otherwise no single thought-knowing at all.
kramikaśabdārūṣitatvāt mātrāyā api kramikatvāt — since word-stained sequential, since even measure sequential.
tsa-a06-v77.inference: Moment = knowing's abiding-time; one breath, one knowing.

tsa-a06-v78.speaker: Citation (measure)
tsa-a06-v78.question: What is said?
premises: yad āha tasyādita udāttam ardhahrasvam iti — which says: raised, half-short.

tsa-a06-v79.speaker: Teacher (between pulses)
tsa-a06-v79.question: What between pulses?
premises: tasmāt spandāntaraṃ yāvat na uditaṃ tāvat ekam eva jñānam — until between-pulses has not arisen, so long one knowing alone.

tsa-a06-v80.speaker: Teacher (eighty-one)
tsa-a06-v80.question: What of eighty-one?
premises: ata eva ekāśīti padasmaraṇasamaye vividhadharmānupraveśamukhena — hence eighty-one, when remembering the word, through entering various natures.
eka eva asau parameśvaraviṣayo vikalpaḥ kālagrāse na avikalpātmā eva sampadyate — that one Lord-objected thought, when time is devoured, results as thought-free-natured alone.
uncertainties: avikalpātmā ending obscure; thought-free sense secure.

tsa-a06-v81.speaker: Teacher (recognition)
tsa-a06-v81.question: What frees?
premises: evam akhilaṃ kālādhvānaṃ prāṇodaya eva paśyan — seeing the entire time-course in breath-rise alone.
sṛṣṭisaṃhārāṃś ca vicitrān niḥsaṃkhyān tatraiva ākalayan — noting countless emissions-dissolutions right there.
ātmana eva pārameśvaryaṃ pratyabhijānan mukta eva bhavati — recognizing lordship by self alone: freed.

tsa-a06-v82.speaker: Teacher (Bhairavī-being)
tsa-a06-v82.question: What is the close?
premises: saṃvidrūpasyātmanaḥ prāṇaśaktiṃ paśyan — seeing the awareness-formed self's breath-power.
rūpaṃ tatragaṃ cātikālam sākaṃ — form going there and beyond time together.
sṛṣṭisthemasaṃhāracakrair nityodyukto bhairavībhāvam eti — with emission-stay-dissolution wheels, ever-ready attains Bhairavī-being.
tsa-a06-v82.inference: Breath-power seen; beyond-time form; ever-ready Bhairavī-being.
uncertainties: cātikālam junction obscure; beyond-time sense from bhairavī-close.

tsa-a06-v01.plain_english: It itself is called by the word seat-fixing. There the seat is threefold — breath-wind, body, and the outer. There first the method in breath: all that course to be stated is reckoned as resting in breath; of it, counting in sequence and non-sequence alone is time. And it shines within the Supreme Lord alone; its shining is the God's power named Kālī; but with division, its appearing in sequence and non-sequence is breath-movement.
tsa-a06-v01.sanskrit_cite: sa eva sthānaprakalpanaśabdena uktaḥ tatra tridhā sthānaṃ prāṇavāyuḥ śarīraṃ bāhyaṃ ca tatra prāṇe tāvat vidhiḥ sarvaḥ asau vakṣyamāṇaḥ adhvā prāṇasthaḥ kalyate tasya kramākramakalanaiva kālaḥ sa ca parameśvara eva antarbhāti tadbhāsanaṃ ca devasya kālī nāma śaktiḥ bhedena tu tadābhāsanaṃ kramākramayoḥ prāṇavṛttiḥ

tsa-a06-v02.plain_english: For consciousness itself takes a form apart from its objects; hence indeed, through being bounded, going to knowability: the void. Then through freedom, falling on the object with eagerness to seize, action-power-led, breathing-formed, living-natured — since with five forms it fills the body, then it shines as if conscious.
tsa-a06-v02.sanskrit_cite: saṃvid eva hi prameyebhyo vibhaktaṃ rūpaṃ gṛhṇāti ata eva ca avacchedayogāt vedyatāṃ yāntī nabhaḥ tataḥ svātantryāt meye svīkārautsukyena nipatantī kriyāśaktipradhānā prāṇanārūpā jīvasvabhāvā pañcabhī rūpaiḥ dehaṃ yataḥ pūrayati tato 'sau cetana iva bhāti

tsa-a06-v03.plain_english: There in power, action is the time-course; in the eastern part, but in the northern, of varied form, is the place-course; there, of letter, mantra, and word courses, the standing in time-course, through beyond-subtle-gross-formedness.
tsa-a06-v03.sanskrit_cite: tatra kriyā śaktau kālādhvā prācyabhāge uttare tu mūrtivaicitryarūpo deśādhvā tatra varṇamantrapadādhvanaḥ kālādhvani sthitiḥ parasūkṣmasthūlarūpatvāt

tsa-a06-v04.plain_english: But the standing of the place-course, as tattva-person-ray-natured — thus it will be in its own place.
tsa-a06-v04.sanskrit_cite: deśādhvasthitis tu tattvapurakalātmanā iti bhaviṣyati svāvasare

tsa-a06-v05.plain_english: There, though even in the body, with outer and inner, breath is warp-and-woof-formed — yet of distinctly sensible effort, that, from the heart beginning — thus from that alone this is to be described.
tsa-a06-v05.sanskrit_cite: tatra yady api dehe sabāhyābhyantaram otaprotarūpaḥ prāṇaḥ tathāpi prasphuṭasaṃvedyaprayatnaḥ asau hṛdayāt prabhṛti iti tata eva ayaṃ nirūpaṇīyaḥ

tsa-a06-v06.plain_english: There lord-power, self-power, and effort — thus a triad — are the cause in driving breath, through secondary-primary states.
tsa-a06-v06.sanskrit_cite: tatra prabhuśaktiḥ ātmaśaktiḥ yatna iti tritayaṃ prāṇeraṇe hetuḥ guṇamukhyabhāvāt

tsa-a06-v07.plain_english: There, from the heart to the twelve-end's end, by one's own fingers, of all is the thirty-six-fingered breath-course, in going out and in coming in, since of each is fitted strength, effort, and body.
tsa-a06-v07.sanskrit_cite: tatra hṛdayāt dvādaśāntāntaṃ svāṅgulaiḥ sarvasya ṣaṭtriṃśadaṅgulaḥ prāṇacāraḥ nirgame praveśe ca svocitabalayatnadehatvāt sarvasya

tsa-a06-v08.plain_english: There the water-clock, the lunar day, the month, the year, and as year-group-natured — thus the entire time is completed. There, in the finger and a fifth, the finger, caṣaka — thus by the rule is the ghaṭikā-rise; for a ghaṭikā is by sixty caṣakas; hence seventy-two-fingered it is.
tsa-a06-v08.sanskrit_cite: tatra ghaṭikā tithiḥ māso varṣaṃ ca varṣasamūhātmā iti samastaḥ kālaḥ parisamāpyate tatra sapañcāṃśe aṅgule caṣaka iti sthityā ghaṭikodayaḥ ghaṭikā hi ṣaṣṭyā caṣakaiḥ tasmāt dvāsaptatyaṅgulā bhavati

tsa-a06-v10.plain_english: Two fingers and a quarter is called tuṭi; in four of them a watch; half tuṭi, half tuṭi — there twilight. Thus in going out day, in coming in night: thus the lunar-day rise.
tsa-a06-v10.sanskrit_cite: sapādam aṅguladvayaṃ tuṭiḥ ucyate tāsu catasṛṣu praharaḥ tuṭyardhaṃ tuṭyardhaṃ tatra saṃdhyā evaṃ nirgame dinaṃ praveśe rātriḥ iti tithyudayaḥ

tsa-a06-v12.plain_english: There day is the dark fortnight, night the bright. There the first half-tuṭi and the last half-tuṭi are untimed rest; but the middle fifteen alone are tuṭis, lunar days. There light is rest and — thus these alone are day and night.
tsa-a06-v12.sanskrit_cite: tatra dinaṃ kṛṣṇapakṣaḥ rātriḥ śuklaḥ tatra pūrvaṃ tuṭyardham antyaṃ ca tuṭyardhaṃ viśrāntiḥ akālakalitāḥ madhyās tu pañcadaśa tuṭaya eva tithayaḥ tatra prakāśo viśrāntiś ca iti ete eva dinaniśe

tsa-a06-v13.plain_english: There the light of knowable-ness is day; of the knowable in the dissolver, dissolution is night. And they — light and rest, through quick-slow variety in endless difference; in sameness with that, equinox.
tsa-a06-v13.sanskrit_cite: tatra vedyamayatāprakāśo dinaṃ vedyasya vicārayitari layo rātriḥ te ca prakāśaviśrāntī cirāciravaicitryāt anantabhede tatsāmye tu viṣuvat

tsa-a06-v14.plain_english: There in the dark fortnight, in the breath-sun, the in-breath-moon offers each single fattening digit, until on the fifteenth, in the tuṭi near the twelve-end, the moon whose digit-spread has thinned and separated dissolves into the breath-sun alone.
tsa-a06-v14.sanskrit_cite: tatra kṛṣṇapakṣe prāṇārke apānacandra āpyāyikām ekām ekāṃ kalām arpayati yāvat pañcadaśyāṃ tuṭau dvādaśāntasamīpe kṣīṇapṛthagbhūtakalāprasaraḥ candramāḥ prāṇārka eva līyate

tsa-a06-v15.plain_english: Right after that, what half-tuṭi there is — that is the fortnight-joint.

tsa-a06-v16.plain_english: And of it, of the half-tuṭi, the eastern half is new-moon, the second first-day.
tsa-a06-v16.sanskrit_cite: tasya ca tuṭyardhasya prācyam ardham āmāvasyaṃ dvitīyaṃ prātipadam

tsa-a06-v17.plain_english: There on the first-day, in that part, when, from cough-effort-attention-made tithi-cutting, it enters — then there is seizure. And there the Māyā-knower-Rāhu, co-born with the object-moon — by nature unable to dissolve, merely capable of covering — drinks the lunar nectar gone to the sun.
tsa-a06-v17.sanskrit_cite: tatra prātipade tasmin bhāge sa āmāvasyo bhāgo yadā kāsaprayatnāvadhānādikṛtāt tithicchedāt viśati tadā tatra grahaṇam tatra ca vedyarūpasomasahabhūto māyāpramātṛrāhuḥ svabhāvatayā vilāpanāśaktaḥ kevalam ācchādanamātrasamarthaḥ sūryagataṃ cāndram amṛtaṃ pibati iti

tsa-a06-v18.plain_english: Since making the knower-measure-known triad non-divided, that time is holy, other-world-fruit-giving.

tsa-a06-v19.plain_english: Then, entering breath, the awareness-sun with each single digit fills the in-breath-moon, until the fifteenth tuṭi is full moon; right after, fortnight-joint and seizure — thus as before. But this is this-world-fruit-giving: thus the month rise.
tsa-a06-v19.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ praviśati prāṇe cidarka ekaikayā kalayā apānacandram āpūrayati yāvat pañcadaśī tuṭiḥ pūrṇimā tadanantaraṃ pakṣasaṃdhiḥ grahaṇaṃ ca iti prāgvat etat tu aihikaphalapradam iti māsodayaḥ

tsa-a06-v21.plain_english: There the dark fortnight alone is the northern course; in six and six fingers is the passage, from Capricorn up to Gemini's end.
tsa-a06-v21.sanskrit_cite: tatra kṛṣṇapakṣa eva uttarāyaṇaṃ ṣaṭsu ṣaṭsu aṅguleṣu saṃkrāntiḥ makarāt mithunāntām

tsa-a06-v22.plain_english: There per finger five lunar days; even there day-and-night division. Thus in coming in the southern course — womb-ness, birth-wish, about-to-be-born-ness, will-be-born-ness, birth-beginning, being-born-ness, birth-and-six-changes — thus in order among Capricorn and the rest.
tsa-a06-v22.sanskrit_cite: tatra pratyaṅgulaṃ pañca tithayaḥ tatrāpi dinarātrivibhāgaḥ evaṃ praveśe dakṣiṇāyanaṃ garbhatvam udbhavecchā udbubhūṣutā udbhaviṣyatvam udbhavārambhaḥ udbhavattā janmādivikāraṣaṭkaṃ ca iti kramāt makarādiṣu iti

tsa-a06-v23.plain_english: Just so worship here does fitting fruit.
tsa-a06-v23.sanskrit_cite: tathaiva upāsā atra phalaṃ samucitaṃ karoti

tsa-a06-v24.plain_english: And here Dakṣa and the rest up to Grandfather, Rudras and powers — twelve lords: thus the year rise.
tsa-a06-v24.sanskrit_cite: atra ca dakṣādyāḥ pitāmahāntā rudrāḥ śaktayaś ca dvādaśādhipataya iti varṣodayaḥ

tsa-a06-v25.plain_english: Per finger sixty lunar days, thus in order at passage a year — thus by this order, in coming and going, twelve-year rise. Per finger of lunar days three hundred in finger-and-a-fifth — a year where before caṣaka was said: thus by counting, at passage five years — thus by this series, in one breath-out-in time sixty-year rise. Here twenty-one thousand six hundred: thus of lunar days the number.
tsa-a06-v25.sanskrit_cite: pratyaṅgulaṃ ṣaṣṭiḥ tithaya iti krameṇa saṃkrāntau varṣam ity anena krameṇa praveśanirgamayoḥ dvādaśābdodayaḥ pratyaṅgulaṃ tithīnāṃ śatatrayaṃ sapañcāṃśe 'ṅgule varṣaṃ yatra prāk caṣakam uktam iti gaṇanayā saṃkrāntau pañca varṣāṇi iti anayā paripāṭyā ekasmin prāṇanirgamapraveśakāle ṣaṣṭyabdodayaḥ atra ekaviṃśatisahasrāṇi ṣaṭ śatāni iti tithīnāṃ saṃkhyā

tsa-a06-v26.plain_english: That many alone in day and night is the breath-count: thus not beyond sixty-year rise is examined, from endlessness.
tsa-a06-v26.sanskrit_cite: tāvatī eva ahorātre prāṇasaṃkhyā iti na ṣaṣṭyabdodayāt adhikaṃ parīkṣyate ānantyāt

tsa-a06-v27.plain_english: There the human year is the gods' lunar day; by this order twelve thousand divine years are four ages.
tsa-a06-v27.sanskrit_cite: tatra mānuṣaṃ varṣaṃ devānāṃ tithiḥ anena krameṇa divyāni dvādaśavarṣasahasrāṇi caturyugam

tsa-a06-v28.plain_english: Four, three, two, one — thus from kṛta beginning, by so many hundreds, eight twilights.
tsa-a06-v28.sanskrit_cite: catvāri trīṇi dve ekam iti kṛtāt prabhṛti tāvadbhiḥ śataiḥ aṣṭau saṃdhyāḥ

tsa-a06-v29.plain_english: By seventy-one four-ages a manu-period; by fourteen manu-periods Brahmā's day. At Brahmā-day's end, in the triple world burnt by time-fire, and elsewhere in the triple world smoke-lulled, all people swiftly, fire-driven, in people-world having become pralaya-kevalas, stand.
tsa-a06-v29.sanskrit_cite: caturyugānām ekasaptatyā manvantaram manvantaraiḥ caturdaśabhiḥ brāhmaṃ dinaṃ brahmadinānte kālāgnidagdhe lokatraye anyatra ca lokatraye dhūmaprasvāpite sarve janā vegavad agnipreritā janaloke pralayākalībhūya tiṣṭhanti

tsa-a06-v30.plain_english: But awakened Kūṣmāṇḍa, Hāṭakeśa and the rest play in the great world.

tsa-a06-v31.plain_english: Then at night's end Brahmā's emission.

tsa-a06-v32.plain_english: By this measure a hundred years is Brahmā-lifespan.

tsa-a06-v33.plain_english: That is Viṣṇu's day, and that much the night; of him too a hundred is the lifespan.
tsa-a06-v33.sanskrit_cite: tat viṣṇoḥ dinaṃ tāvatī ca rātriḥ tasyāpi śatam āyuḥ

tsa-a06-v34.plain_english: That day; above that, O Rudra-world-lord, Rudra's; that much night; as before a year. That hundred too — and the limit.
tsa-a06-v34.sanskrit_cite: tat dinaṃ tadūrdhve rudralokaprabho rudrasya tāvatī rātriḥ prāgvat varṣaṃ tacchatam api ca avadhiḥ

tsa-a06-v35.plain_english: There at Rudra's end, going to Śiva-ness; Rudra's stated office-limit. Of world-egg bearers that day; of a hundred Rudras night that much; of them too a hundred is the lifespan.
tsa-a06-v35.sanskrit_cite: tatra rudrasya tadavasitau śivatvagatiḥ rudrasya uktādhikārāvadhiḥ brahmāṇḍadhārakāṇāṃ tat dinaṃ śatarudrāṇāṃ niśā tāvatī teṣām api ca śatam āyuḥ

tsa-a06-v36.plain_english: When a hundred Rudras end — world-egg destruction.

tsa-a06-v37.plain_english: Thus from water-principle up to the unmanifest, this alone in order is the Rudras' lifespan.
tsa-a06-v37.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ jalatattvāt avyaktāntam etad eva krameṇa rudrāṇām āyuḥ

tsa-a06-v38.plain_english: The earlier's lifespan is the later's day: thus.

tsa-a06-v39.plain_english: And then Brahmā and Rudras are unobstructed officers standing in the unmanifest: thus.
tsa-a06-v39.sanskrit_cite: tataś ca brahmā rudrāś ca abādyadhikāriṇaḥ avyakte tiṣṭhanti iti

tsa-a06-v40.plain_english: And then Śrīkaṇṭha-lord is the withdrawer.

tsa-a06-v41.plain_english: This is intermediate dissolution; on its ending, emission.

tsa-a06-v42.plain_english: There other scriptures, stated, too are emitted.

tsa-a06-v43.plain_english: But Śrīkaṇṭha-lord's own lifespan — that is the sheath-dwellers' Rudras' day, that much the night; their lifespan — that is Gahaneśa-day, that much alone the night; and in her the entire alone dissolves in Māyā.
tsa-a06-v43.sanskrit_cite: yat tu śrīkaṇṭhanāthasya svam āyuḥ tat kañcukavāsināṃ rudrāṇāṃ dinaṃ tāvatī rajanī teṣāṃ yad āyuḥ tat gahaneśadinaṃ tāvatī eva kṣapā tasyāṃ ca samastam eva māyāyāṃ vilīyate

tsa-a06-v45.plain_english: Thus which unmanifest-time — having multiplied it by ten half-highests one should tell Māyā-day, that much the night.
tsa-a06-v45.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yaḥ avyaktakālaḥ taṃ daśabhiḥ parārdhaiḥ guṇayitvā māyādinaṃ kathayet tāvatī rātriḥ

tsa-a06-v47.plain_english: Māyā-time multiplied by a hundred half-highests is a day in Īśvara-principle.

tsa-a06-v48.plain_english: Here breath emits the world, that much the night. Where breath-quiet — even in breath and in Brahman-cave-abode, in the quiet, which consciousness — even there is sequence.
tsa-a06-v48.sanskrit_cite: atra prāṇo jagat sṛjati tāvatī rātriḥ yatra prāṇapraśamaḥ prāṇe ca brahmabiladhāmni śānte 'pi yā saṃvit tatrāpy asti kramaḥ

tsa-a06-v49.plain_english: In Īśvara time multiplied by a hundred half-highests, whatever the number — that is Sadāśiva day, that much the night; that alone is the great dissolution.
tsa-a06-v49.sanskrit_cite: aiśvare kāle parārdhaśataguṇite yā saṃkhyā tat sādāśivaṃ dinaṃ tāvatī niśā sa eva mahāpralayaḥ

tsa-a06-v50.plain_english: Sadāśiva, when own time ends, having ascended drop-half-moon-blocker, dissolves in resonance; resonance in power-principle, that in the pervader, and she in the Unsupported.
tsa-a06-v50.sanskrit_cite: sadāśivaḥ svakālaparikṣaye bindvardhacandranirodhikā ākramya nāde līyate nādaḥ śaktitattve tat vyāpinyāṃ sā ca anāśrite

tsa-a06-v51.plain_english: By power-time multiplied by ten-million half-highests — Unsupported-day.

tsa-a06-v52.plain_english: The Unsupported in the like-minded station — which, that likeness, sameness; that is Brahman.
tsa-a06-v52.sanskrit_cite: anāśritaḥ sāmanase pade yat tat sāmanasyaṃ sāmyaṃ tat brahma

tsa-a06-v53.plain_english: From this likeness, from the partless, from time, by mere winking measure — the stated wheel-whirl rise of all time's spread and re-dissolution.

tsa-a06-v54.plain_english: One, ten, hundred, thousand, ten thousand, hundred thousand, million, ten million, hundred million, billion, ten billion, hundred billion, thousand billion, ten-thousand billion, ocean, end, middle, half-highest — thus in order ten-multiplied, eighteen: thus the counting-rule.
tsa-a06-v54.sanskrit_cite: ekaṃ daśa śataṃ sahasram ayutaṃ lakṣaṃ niyutaṃ koṭiḥ arbudaṃ vṛndaṃ kharvaṃ nikharvaṃ padmaṃ śaṅkuḥ samudram antyaṃ madhyam parārdham iti krameṇa daśaguṇitāni aṣṭādaśa iti gaṇitavidhiḥ

tsa-a06-v55.plain_english: Thus countless emissions-dissolutions in one great-emission-formed breath — it too in consciousness, she in the adjunct, it in bare awareness, of bare awareness alone this pulse which is called this time-rise.
tsa-a06-v55.sanskrit_cite: evam asaṃkhyāḥ sṛṣṭipralayāḥ ekasmin mahāsṛṣṭirūpe prāṇe so 'pi saṃvidi sā upādhau sa cinmātre cinmātrasyaiva ayaṃ spando yad ayaṃ kālodayo nāma

tsa-a06-v56.plain_english: From that alone, in dream-fancy and the rest, variety of this brings no contradiction.
tsa-a06-v56.sanskrit_cite: tata eva svapnasaṃkalpādau vaicitryam asya na virodhāvaham

tsa-a06-v57.plain_english: Thus as in out-breath is time-rise, so too in in-breath, from the heart to the root-seat's end.
tsa-a06-v57.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ yathā prāṇe kālodayaḥ tathā apāne 'pi hṛdayāt mūlapīṭhaparyantam

tsa-a06-v58.plain_english: And as in heart-throat-palate-brow-cleft-twelve-ends the six causes called Brahmā-Viṣṇu-Rudra-Īśa-Sadāśiva-Unsupported, just so too in in-breath, in heart-bulb-bliss-contraction-expansion-twelve-ends — these childhood-youth-age-rebirth-release lords.
tsa-a06-v58.sanskrit_cite: yathā ca hṛtkaṇṭhatālulalāṭarandhradvādaśānteṣu brahmaviṣṇurudreśasadāśivānāśritākhyaṃ kāraṇaṣaṭkam tathaiva apāne 'pi hṛtkandānandasaṃkocavikāsadvādaśānteṣu bālyayauvanavārddhakanidhanapunarbhavamuktyadhipataya ete

tsa-a06-v60.plain_english: The equal-breath, moving in the ten heart-channels, conveys juices and the rest evenly through the whole body. There moving in the eight directions, it imitates as it were the regents' doings of the knower.
tsa-a06-v60.sanskrit_cite: samāno hārdīṣu daśāsu nāḍīṣu saṃcaran samaste dehe sāmyena rasādīn vāhayati tatra digaṣṭake saṃcaran taddikpaticeṣṭām iva pramātuḥ anukārayati

tsa-a06-v61.plain_english: But moving up and down, in three channels it does going-coming.
tsa-a06-v61.sanskrit_cite: ūrdhvādhas tu saṃcaran tisṛṣu nāḍīṣu gatāgataṃ karoti

tsa-a06-v62.plain_english: There on equinox-day, outside, at dawn-time, a ghaṭikā and a quarter it carries in the middle path.
tsa-a06-v62.sanskrit_cite: tatra viṣuvaddine bāhye prabhātakāle sapādāṃ ghaṭikāṃ madhyamārge vahati

tsa-a06-v63.plain_english: Then nine hundred breath-castings — thus by counting, outside two and a half ghaṭikās — left, right, left, right, left — thus five passages.
tsa-a06-v63.sanskrit_cite: tato navaśatāni prāṇavikṣepāṇām iti gaṇanayā bahiḥ sārdhaghaṭikādvayaṃ vāme dakṣiṇe vāme dakṣiṇe vāme iti pañca saṃkrāntayaḥ

tsa-a06-v64.plain_english: Then when the five-passage has elapsed, in less-a-quarter fourteen passed ghaṭikās, at southern autumnal equinox-midday, nine breath-hundreds.
tsa-a06-v64.sanskrit_cite: tataḥ saṃkrāntipañcake vṛtte pādonāsu caturdaśasu ghaṭikāsu atikrāntāsu dakṣiṇaṃ śāradaṃ viṣuvanmadhyāhne nava prāṇaśatāni

tsa-a06-v65.plain_english: Then too right, left, right, left, right — thus a five-passage, nine hundred each — thus even at night — thus.
tsa-a06-v65.sanskrit_cite: tato 'pi dakṣiṇe vāme dakṣiṇe vāme dakṣiṇe iti saṃkrāntipañcakaṃ pratyekaṃ navaśatāni ity evaṃ rātrāv api iti

tsa-a06-v66.plain_english: Thus on equinox-day and its night, twelve and twelve passages.
tsa-a06-v66.sanskrit_cite: evaṃ viṣuvaddivase tadrātrau ca dvādaśa dvādaśa saṃkrāntayaḥ

tsa-a06-v67.plain_english: Then in day wax-wane, passage wax-wane.

tsa-a06-v68.plain_english: Thus in one equal-breath-wind two years, from absence of in-out-breath union.

tsa-a06-v69.plain_english: Even here twelve-year-rise and the rest as before.

tsa-a06-v70.plain_english: But in up-breath the course is twelve-end-limited, of mere-pulse-natured time.
tsa-a06-v70.sanskrit_cite: udāne tu dvādaśāntāvadhiś cāraḥ spandamātrātmanaḥ kālasya

tsa-a06-v71.plain_english: Even here as before the rule.

tsa-a06-v72.plain_english: But in pervading-breath, from pervasiveness, even in non-sequence, by subtle-surging-ness is time-rise.
tsa-a06-v72.sanskrit_cite: vyāne tu vyāpakatvāt akrame 'pi sūkṣmocchalattāyogena kālodayaḥ

tsa-a06-v74.plain_english: There in half-watch, in half-watch, class-rise is even at equinox; of the letter, of the letter, two hundred sixteen breaths; outside thirty-six caṣakas: thus this rise, effortless-born letter-rise.
tsa-a06-v74.sanskrit_cite: tatra ardhaprahare ardhaprahare vargodayo viṣuvati samaḥ varṇasya varṇasya dve śate ṣoḍaśādhike prāṇānām bahiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśat caṣakāṇi iti udayaḥ ayam ayatnajo varṇodayaḥ

tsa-a06-v75.plain_english: But effort-born is mantra-rise: like a water-wheel-device drawing, by single-attention force — wondrous mantra-rise day and night keeping joined — with the mantra-deity gains identity.
tsa-a06-v75.sanskrit_cite: yatnajas tu mantrodayaḥ araghaṭṭaghaṭīyantravāhanavat ekānusaṃdhibalāt citraṃ mantrodayaṃ divāniśam anusaṃdadhat mantradevatayā saha tādātmyam eti

tsa-a06-v76.plain_english: There in the ever-arisen, by breath-course count alone is rise-count explained; when that doubled, its half, and the rest in order; in the hundred-and-eight wheel, two hundred the rise: thus in order. In gross-subtle course-nature of the rested one, when breath-course has thinned, when time is devoured come about, complete, one, just this awareness, wonder-power-filled, shines.
tsa-a06-v76.sanskrit_cite: tatra sadodite prāṇacārasaṃkhyayaiva udayasaṃkhyā vyākhyātā taddviguṇite tadardham ityādi krameṇa aṣṭottaraśate cakre dviśata udayaḥ iti krameṇa sthūlasūkṣme cārasvarūpe viśrāntasya prāṇacāre kṣīṇe kālagrāse vṛtte sampūrṇām ekam evedaṃ saṃvedanaṃ citraśaktinirbharaṃ bhāsate

tsa-a06-v77.plain_english: Time-difference alone divides awareness, not object-difference — like peak-abiding knowledge. Of knowing, as much as the abiding-time, that alone is the moment. And in one breath-rise, one knowing alone necessarily — and this: otherwise there would be no single thought-knowing at all, since word-sequenced-stained, since even the measure is sequential.
tsa-a06-v77.sanskrit_cite: kālabheda eva saṃvedanabhedakaḥ na vedyabhedaḥ śikharasthajñānavat jñānasya yāvān avasthitikālaḥ sa eva kṣaṇaḥ prāṇodaye ca ekasmin ekam eva jñānam avaśyaṃ caitat anyathā vikalpajñānam ekaṃ na kiṃcit syāt kramikaśabdārūṣitatvāt mātrāyā api kramikatvāt

tsa-a06-v78.plain_english: Which has said: the raised, half-short — thus.
tsa-a06-v78.sanskrit_cite: yad āha tasyādita udāttam ardhahrasvam iti

tsa-a06-v79.plain_english: Therefore until between pulses has not arisen, so long one knowing alone.
tsa-a06-v79.sanskrit_cite: tasmāt spandāntaraṃ yāvat na uditaṃ tāvat ekam eva jñānam

tsa-a06-v80.plain_english: Hence very eighty-one, when remembering the word, through entering various natures — that one alone, having the Lord as object, that thought, when time is devoured, results as thought-free-natured alone — thus.
tsa-a06-v80.sanskrit_cite: ata eva ekāśīti padasmaraṇasamaye vividhadharmānupraveśamukhena eka eva asau parameśvaraviṣayo vikalpaḥ kālagrāse na avikalpātmā eva sampadyate iti

tsa-a06-v81.plain_english: Thus seeing the entire time-course in breath-rise alone, and the various countless emissions-dissolutions, noting right there, by self alone recognizing lordship — one is freed alone — thus.
tsa-a06-v81.sanskrit_cite: evam akhilaṃ kālādhvānaṃ prāṇodaya eva paśyan sṛṣṭisaṃhārāṃś ca vicitrān niḥsaṃkhyān tatraiva ākalayan ātmana eva pārameśvaryaṃ pratyabhijānan mukta eva bhavati iti

tsa-a06-v82.plain_english: Seeing the awareness-formed self's breath-power, the form going there and beyond time together, with emission-stay-dissolution wheels, ever-ready attains Bhairavī-being.
tsa-a06-v82.sanskrit_cite: saṃvidrūpasyātmanaḥ prāṇaśaktiṃ paśyan rūpaṃ tatragaṃ cātikālam sākaṃ sṛṣṭisthemasaṃhāracakrair nityodyukto bhairavībhāvam eti

sections.FUNCTION: Establishes sthāna-kalana (seat-fixing): three seats with breath first, the whole course reckoned breath-resting, time as sequence-non-sequence counting shining within the Lord as Kālī — then the full time-ladder (ghaṭikā/tithi/māsa/varṣa, tuṭi arithmetic, pakṣa-sandhi and grahaṇa, nakṣatra-yogas, twelve to sixty-year scales, 21,600 breaths) ascending through divine ages, manu-periods, Brahmā-to-Gahaneśa lifespans, pralaya tiers to anāśrita-sāmanasya-brahman — closing with apāna/samāna/udāna/vyāna courses, varṇodaya/mantrodaya, the kāla-grāsa doctrine (one breath one knowing), and recognition-liberation in bhairavībhāva.
sections.KEY TERMS: sthānaprakalpana (seat-fixing: prāṇa/śarīra/bāhya); kramākramakalana (sequence-non-sequence counting = time); Kālī (God's shining power); tuṭi (2¼ fingers; prahara, sandhyā); pakṣasaṃdhi (fortnight-joint); grahaṇa (seizure: Māyā-knower-Rāhu); nakṣatra-graha-yoga (conjunctions); parārdha (half-highest multiplier); pralayākala (dissolution-state); anāśrita/sāmanasya (Unsupported/likeness); spanda (pulse); varṇodaya/mantrodaya (letter/mantra rise; water-wheel simile); kālagrāsa (time-devouring); kṣaṇa (moment = knowing's abiding-time); pratyabhijñā (recognition); bhairavībhāva (Bhairavī-being).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 6 opens the outer method's first seat (prāṇa) after the upāya ahnikas (a03–a05); sthāna-doctrine continued in a07 (tattva-ladder) and a08; time-ladder kin to Tantrāloka 6–8 (adhva reckoning). Witnesses: OccultGuide full translation, Pradīpaka word-by-word, Chakravarty/Bertagni English — parallels, not sources.
sections.EXPLANATION: The ahnika runs: (1) charter — seat-fixing word, three seats, breath-first method, course reckoned breath-resting, time as counting, Kālī within, breath-movement without; (2) descent — consciousness apart-formed, bounded void, eager falling, breathing body seeming conscious; (3) placement — time-course in power, place-course varied, letter-courses standing, place deferred; (4) measure — heart-start, triad drivers, 36 fingers, whole time completed, caṣaka rule; (5) tithi — tuṭi, watch, twilight, day-night breathing, month joints, fortnight halves, knowable-light doctrine, waxing-filling, joint, seizure with Rāhu, holiness, waning with this-world fruit; (6) year — rise, northern passages, southern gestation series, worship fruit, twelve lords, sixty-day and twelve/sixty-year scales, 21,600 count, inquiry limit; (7) cosmic ages — divine years, twilights, manu-periods, Brahmā-day fire-stance, awakened players, night-end emission, Brahmā–Viṣṇu–Rudra lifespans, hundred-Rudra scale, world-egg destruction, ladder rule, unmanifest officers, Śrīkaṇṭha withdrawal, interval, other scriptures; (8) higher days — Śrīkaṇṭha-to-Gahaneśa ladder, Māyā-dissolution, re-emission, ten-multiplied Māyā-day, Īśvara-day, breath-quiet sequence, Sadāśiva number with great dissolution, drop-blocker ascent to Unsupported, ten-million Unsupported-day, likeness-sameness Brahman, winking wheel-whirl; (9) number names and pulse — eighteen names, countless in one breath, dream-consistency, apāna sameness, six-and-six causes, samāna channels and equinox passages, udāna/vyāna limits, letter-rise effortless, mantra-rise water-wheel with deity-identity; (10) grāsa and close — breath-count rise-numbers, thinning and devouring with complete awareness, moment doctrine, measure-fragment, between-pulse oneness, eighty-one memories devoured, seeing-noting-recognizing freedom, Bhairavī-being.
